title: Skip the Windows and macOS jobs on docs-only PRs; CodeQL advanced setup with Swift only when Swift changed
goal: A docs-only PR starts no Windows or macOS runner and still passes its required checks; Swift CodeQL runs only when Swift changed
acceptance: A changed-paths step in the CI plan job sets docs_only for a PR whose files are all under docs/, a root *.md or LICENSE; windows and native-macos skip at job level only then and only when the plan selected no work for them; no workflow-level paths filter
Pushes to main, the merge queue, manual and scheduled runs always run both jobs

.github/workflows/codeql.yml analyses actions and javascript-typescript on every PR and push to main with the default suite, and swift only when a .swift file, native/NervMenuBar/** or the workflow changed (always on schedule and manual runs)
The action pins are in ciActionPins and checked by test/ci-pins.test.mjs
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
validation: CI on this PR (full: the workflow changed); a later docs-only PR shows windows and native-macos skipped
escalation: Changing required checks or repository settings goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25 when opened: read the cancelled jobs, two workflow edits, tests and docs. Not a measurement.
